subject: DI05005051

title.en: Elemental phosphorus and phosphoric acid—properties and uses

h.en: Elemental phosphorus and phosphoric acid—properties and uses

body.en:
Elemental phosphorus

Phosphorus is an element with distinct allotropes. White/yellow phosphorus is molecular P4,a waxy, highly reactive toxic material requiring specialist oxygen-excluding containment;red phosphorus has a polymeric structure and different reactivity. These are not interchangeable grades. Elemental phosphorus oxidises to phosphorus oxides and is an intermediate for thermal acid and other qualified chemicals. It is not itself ordinary phosphate fertilizer.

Phosphoric acid

Orthophosphoric acid, H3PO4,is a nonvolatile triprotic acid relative to volatile mineral acids;commercial aqueous solutions are clear to coloured depending on impurities. Concentrated solutions are viscous. It forms different phosphate salts according to neutralisation and can dehydrate to condensed phosphates under suitable processing. Fertilizer uses include ammonium phosphates and acidulation of rock;purified food/technical uses require distinct specifications. Wet-process acid is not automatically food grade.
body.gu:
Elemental Phosphorus

Phosphorus ના allotropes જુદા છે. White/yellowP4 waxy, highly reactive/toxic છે તથા specialist oxygen-excluding containment જોઈએ;red phosphorus polymeric structure/જુદી reactivity ધરાવે છે. Grades interchangeable નથી. Oxidation થી phosphorus oxides બને છે;thermal acid/qualified chemicals માટે intermediate છે, ordinary phosphate fertilizer નહીં.

Phosphoric Acid

Orthophosphoric acid, H3PO4,triprotic તથા volatile mineral acids ની સરખામણીએ nonvolatile છે;impurities મુજબ solution clear/coloured તથા concentrated form viscous છે. Neutralisation થી જુદાં phosphates અને processing થી condensed phosphates બને છે. Ammonium phosphates/rock acidulation માં ઉપયોગ;food/technical grades માટે અલગ specs જોઈએ. Wet acid આપમેળે food grade નથી.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

Electric-furnace phosphorus production reduces phosphate mineral with carbon in the presence of silica and recovers phosphorus vapour.

Raw materials and principle

Phosphate rock, coke, silica and electrical energy, with qualified cooling/containment utilities.

2Ca3(PO4)2+6SiO2+10C→P4+6CaSiO3+10CO.

Source identification

These are near-duplicate source sheets. Page17 is the fuller figure. Prepare phosphate rock, coke and silica;electrothermally reduce the charge, remove dust from phosphorus/CO gas, condense P4 under water and separate slag. Red-phosphorus conversion is an optional branch, not the phosphoric-acid absorption section. No operating recipe for reactive phosphorus.

Original reference—page 14

Original reference—page 17

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source shows grinding/sintering, screening, a submerged-electrode electric furnace, slag handling, gas-dust removal and water-spray condensation. Phosphorus-containing gas has a distinct path from molten slag;the downstream red-phosphorus/acid branches are optional separate duties.

1.Charge preparation and electrothermal reduction

Prepared rock, coke and silica form a suitably qualified furnace charge. Electrical heating enables reduction of phosphate;silica binds calcium as silicate slag and carbon is oxidised to CO.Phosphorus emerges in a hot gas rather than as the same molten stream as slag. Fines recycle and charge permeability affect furnace performance.

2.Dust removal and phosphorus condensation

Hot gas passes through dust-removal equipment before phosphorus is condensed in the engineered water-contact system. Recovered reactive phosphorus remains under suitable specialist containment;CO-rich off-gas has its own approved recovery/treatment. The slag stream is separately cooled/handled after qualification.

3.Branch identification

The source batch red-phosphorus conversion is not the same as burning phosphorus to make acid. The common furnace section can feed distinct product routes according to design. This study intentionally gives no operating recipe for producing, handling or converting reactive phosphorus.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Electrical energy demand, electrode/refractory wear, charge dust, CO containment, phosphorus losses and reactive-product containment are major issues.

Applications / product boundary

Intermediate for thermal phosphoric acid and other authorised phosphorus chemicals.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

Silica ની હાજરીમાં carbon થી phosphate mineral reduce કરીને phosphorus vapour recover કરવો electric-furnace process છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Phosphate rock, coke, silica, electrical energy તથા qualified cooling/containment.

2Ca3(PO4)2+6SiO2+10C→P4+6CaSiO3+10CO.

Source ની ઓળખ

પાનાં 14/17 near-duplicates છે;17 વધુ complete છે. Rock, coke/silica preparation પછી electrothermal reduction, dust removal, water હેઠળ P4 condensation તથા slag separation છે. Red-phosphorus conversion optional branch છે, acid absorption નહીં. Reactive phosphorus માટે operating recipe નથી.

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 14

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 17

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Source માં grinding/sintering, screening, electric furnace, slag handling, gas-dust removal તથા water-spray condenser છે. Phosphorus gas તથા slag ના paths જુદા છે;red-P/acid branches separate optional duties છે.

1.Charge Preparation તથા Electrothermal Reduction

Prepared rock, coke/silica furnace charge બને છે. Electric heat થી phosphate reduce થાય છે;silica calcium ને silicate slag માં બાંધે છે અને carbon થી CO બને છે. Phosphorus hot gas માં જાય છે, slag ના same melt માં નહીં. Fines recycle/permeability performance ને અસર કરે છે.

2.Dust Removal તથા Condensation

Hot gas dust-removal પછી engineered water-contact system માં Pcondense કરે છે. ReactivePspecialist containment માં રહે છે;CO off-gas નું approved recovery/treatment અલગ છે. Slag અલગ cool/handle થાય છે.

3.Branch ની ઓળખ

Source નો batch red-Pconversion phosphorus burn કરીને acid બનાવવાથી જુદો છે. Common furnace section design મુજબ અલગ products આપે છે. Reactive phosphorus production/handling/conversion માટે operating recipe નથી.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Energy demand, electrode/refractory wear, dust, CO containment, P loss તથા reactive-product containment મુખ્ય મુદ્દા છે.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Thermal phosphoric acid તથા authorised phosphorus chemicals માટે intermediate.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

Sulphuric-acid wet processing digests phosphate rock and separates a calcium-sulfate solid from phosphoric-acid liquor.

Raw materials and principle

Ground phosphate rock, sulphuric acid, water and recycled product/wash liquor.

Ca3(PO4)2+3H2SO4+6H2O→2H3PO4+3CaSO4·2H2O(idealised tricalcium-phosphate/dihydrate model).

Source identification

Reference:ground rock+acid/recycle liquor→agitated reaction→gypsum filtration/washing→acid concentration;fluoride-bearing gas goes to scrubbers. Strong H2SO4 is a reagent;it does not mean all product acid leaves already concentrated. The source is schematic and readable duties are preserved.

Original reference—page 15

Construction and equipment arrangement

Agitated acidulation vessels receive metered feeds and recycle liquor. Gypsum filtration/washing follows, with fluoride-bearing gas scrubbing and a separate acid evaporator. The gypsum crystal form depends on the selected wet-process technology;the displayed balance uses a dihydrate model.

1.Rock acidulation and crystal development

Acid attack releases phosphate into solution while calcium forms sulfate crystals. Mixing, acid strength and recycle control both reaction completion and gypsum filterability. Real rock contains fluorides and other impurities, so the tricalcium-phosphate equation is only an ideal model, not a full ore analysis.

2.Filtration, washing and concentration

Filtration separates gypsum and washing recovers adhering acid;wash liquor is reused within the water balance. The filtrate is phosphoric acid of a process-dependent strength and is concentrated if the required grade demands it. Gas scrubbing captures fluoride-bearing emissions;gypsum residue requires authorised management.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Poor gypsum crystals blind filters and trap P2O5 equivalent;corrosion, scale, fluoride capture, evaporation energy and phosphogypsum impurities are major concerns.

Applications / product boundary

Fertilizer-grade acid for ammonium phosphates, TSP and other suitable products;purified grades require extra treatment.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

Sulphuric-acid wet process માં rock digest કરીને phosphoric-acid liquor થી calcium-sulfate solid અલગ થાય છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Ground rock, H2SO4,water તથા recycled product/wash liquor.

Ca3(PO4)2+3H2SO4+6H2O→2H3PO4+3CaSO4·2H2O(idealised tricalcium-phosphate/dihydrate model).

Source ની ઓળખ

Reference:ground rock+acid/recycle liquor→agitated reaction→gypsum filtration/washing→acid concentration;fluoride gas scrubbers માં જાય છે. Strong H2SO4 reagent છે, તેથી product આપમેળે concentrated નથી. Readable duties જાળવવાં.

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 15

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Agitated acidulation vessels માં feeds/recycle આવે છે. Gypsum filtration/washing, fluoride-gas scrubbing તથા અલગ acid evaporator છે. Crystal form technology મુજબ બદલાય છે;displayed balance dihydrate model છે.

1.Rock Acidulation તથા Crystal Development

Acid attack થી phosphate solution માં તથા calcium sulfate crystals માં જાય છે. Mixing, acid strength/recycle થી completion તથા gypsum filterability નક્કી થાય છે. Real rock માં fluorides/other impurities છે;equation ideal model છે, full ore analysis નહીં.

2.Filtration, Washing તથા Concentration

Filtration gypsum કાઢે છે;washing adhering acid recover કરે છે અને wash liquor water balance મુજબ reuse થાય છે. Filtrate process-dependent strength નું H3PO4 છે;grade મુજબ concentrate થાય છે. Scrubbing fluoride gas પકડે છે;gypsum નું authorised management જોઈએ.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Poor gypsum crystals થી filters block તથા phosphate loss થાય છે;corrosion, scale, fluoride capture, energy/phosphogypsum impurities મુખ્ય મુદ્દા છે.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Ammonium phosphates, TSP/other suitable products માટે fertilizer acid;purified grades માં extra treatment જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

The HCl route digests rock with hydrochloric acid, then separates/recover phosphoric acid from a calcium-chloride-bearing solution.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified phosphate rock, HCl, water and the selected licensed extraction solvent system.

Ca3(PO4)2+6HCl→2H3PO4+3CaCl2(idealised rock model).

Source identification

Reference:leaching, water-washing thickeners, mixer-settler extraction/washing/back-extraction, solvent stripper and staged acid concentration/HCl recovery. Calcium chloride stays mainly in the aqueous residue;solvent and HCl recovery are distinct loops. Exact product percentages printed in the scan are not universal.

Original reference—page 16

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source includes a leach vessel, washing thickeners, mixer-settler extraction/washing/back-extraction stages, a solvent stripper and staged acid concentration/HCl recovery. Mixer and settler duties provide contact and phase separation rather than one single undifferentiated tank.

1.Leaching and insoluble removal

HCl attack releases phosphoric acid and calcium chloride into the aqueous system. Insolubles are removed and washed in the thickener train to recover acid-bearing liquid. The clarified liquor still contains dissolved calcium chloride, so filtration alone cannot produce purified phosphoric acid.

2.Extraction, phase separation and solvent return

The selected solvent transfers phosphoric-acid-bearing material into the organic phase while much calcium chloride remains in the aqueous raffinate. Washing removes co-extracted impurities and back-extraction recovers acid into the selected product stream. The solvent stripper/regeneration duty prevents uncontrolled loss and buildup.

3.HCl recovery and final acid

Staged concentration removes/recycles volatile HCl and adjusts product acid strength. The solvent and HCl loops have different compositions and cannot be merged blindly. Calcium-chloride-rich residual liquor and contaminated solvent require approved recovery/treatment.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Corrosion, solvent selectivity/emulsion formation, phase disengagement, acid loss and chloride-bearing waste are key problems.

Applications / product boundary

Phosphoric acid after route-specific purification and analytical release.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

HCl route માં rock digest થયા પછી CaCl2-containing solution માંથી H3PO4 separate/recover થાય છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Qualified rock, HCl, water તથા selected licensed extraction-solvent system.

Ca3(PO4)2+6HCl→2H3PO4+3CaCl2(idealised rock model).

Source ની ઓળખ

Reference માં leaching, washing thickeners, mixer-settler extraction/washing/back-extraction, solvent stripper તથા staged concentration/HCl recovery છે. CaCl2 મુખ્યત્વે aqueous residue માં રહે છે;solvent તથા HCl loops જુદા છે. Printed percentages universal નથી.

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 16

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Source માં leach vessel, washing thickeners, mixer-settler extraction/washing/back-extraction, solvent stripper તથા staged acid/HCl recovery છે. Mixer contact અને settler phase separation આપે છે, એક undifferentiated tank નહીં.

1.Leaching તથા Insoluble Removal

HCl attack થી H3PO4/CaCl2 aqueous system માં આવે છે. Insolubles thickener train માં remove/wash થાય છે. Clarified liquor માં dissolved CaCl2 રહે છે;ફક્ત filtration થી purified acid મળતું નથી.

2.Extraction તથા Solvent Return

Selected solvent acid-bearing material organic phase માં લે છે અને મોટાભાગનું CaCl2 aqueous raffinate માં રહે છે. Washing co-extracted impurities કાઢે છે;back-extraction થી acid product stream માં મળે છે. Solvent regeneration loss/buildup રોકે છે.

3.HCl Recovery તથા Final Acid

Staged concentration થી volatile HCl recover/recycle તથા product strength adjust થાય છે. Solvent/HCl loops ની composition જુદી છે. CaCl2-rich liquor/contaminated solvent નું approved recovery/treatment જોઈએ.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Corrosion, selectivity/emulsion, phase disengagement, acid loss તથા chloride waste મુખ્ય મુદ્દા છે.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Route-specific purification/analytical release પછી phosphoric acid.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

Thermal phosphoric acid is made by burning elemental phosphorus to phosphorus oxide and hydrating/absorbing that oxide.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified elemental phosphorus, air and hydration/absorption water.

P4+5O2→P4O10;P4O10+6H2O→4H3PO4.

Source identification

Follow only the phosphorus→combustion chamber→P4O10 hydration/absorption→demister/purification branch. The source also includes a dry-air phosphorus-oxide product branch, which is not hydrated phosphoric acid. Although listed under wet-process subheadings in the syllabus, the electric-furnace/thermal route is not wet-acid leaching.

Original reference—page 17

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source branch has a phosphorus combustion chamber, hydration/absorption equipment, demisting and optional purification. The upstream electric furnace makes elemental phosphorus;it is not itself a wet-acid leach reactor. A dry-air oxide branch in the full source is a separate product route.

1.Oxidation and heat removal

Controlled industrial phosphorus oxidation forms P4O10 with substantial heat release. Gas handling and heat removal contain the reactive feed and prevent uncontrolled mist/dust escape. The simplified historical label P2O5 denotes the empirical oxide formula, not a different hydration reaction.

2.Hydration, absorption and demisting

Water hydrates the oxide to phosphoric acid while circulation/cooling controls absorption heat. A demister captures acid mist rather than separating solid gypsum as in the wet process. Polishing adjusts impurities for the intended grade;thermal manufacture often gives a cleaner starting acid butdoes not eliminate testing.

Major engineering / quality considerations

High energy demand of elemental-Pproduction, reactive feed containment, thermal duty and acid-mist capture dominate.

Applications / product boundary

Qualified higher-purity acid applications and phosphate manufacture according to grade;not classified as wet-rock leaching.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

ElementalP ને burn કરીને oxide તથા તેના hydration/absorption થી thermalH3PO4 બને છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Qualified elementalP, air તથા hydration/absorption water.

P4+5O2→P4O10;P4O10+6H2O→4H3PO4.

Source ની ઓળખ

Phosphorus→combustion chamber→P4O10 hydration/absorption→demister/purification branch અનુસરો. Dry-air oxide-product branch phosphoric acid નથી. Syllabus માં wet-process subheading હેઠળ હોવા છતાં thermal route wet-acid leaching નથી.

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 17

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Source branch માં combustion chamber, hydration/absorption, demister તથા optional purification છે. Upstream furnace elementalP બનાવે છે, wet leach reactor નહીં. Full source નો dry-air oxide branch જુદો product route છે.

1.Oxidation તથા Heat Removal

Controlled oxidation થી heat સાથે P4O10 બને છે. Gas handling/heat removal reactive feed તથા mist/dust ને contain કરે છે. HistoricalP2O5 empirical formula છે, જુદી hydration chemistry નહીં.

2.Hydration, Absorption તથા Demisting

Water oxide ને acid માં hydrate કરે છે;circulation/cooling absorption heat નિયંત્રિત કરે છે. Demister acid mist પકડે છે, wet process જેવું gypsum નહીં. Polishing grade impurities adjust કરે છે;cleaner starting acid છતાં tests જરૂરી છે.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

ElementalP ની energy demand, reactive-feed containment, thermal duty/acid mist મુખ્ય મુદ્દા છે.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Grade મુજબ higher-purity acid/phosphate manufacture;wet-rock leaching તરીકે classify ન કરવું.

title.gu: Phosphorus તથા Phosphoric Acidની Engineering Problems

h.gu: Phosphorus તથા Phosphoric Acidની Engineering Problems

body.en:
Furnace and thermal route

Rock impurities, charge sizing, electrical load, electrode consumption and refractory wear affect furnace reliability. Slag/fines/phosphorus losses and CO/reactive-product containment require dedicated systems. Thermal acid additionally needs combustion-heat and acid-mist control.

Wet and extraction routes

Wet-acid plants face gypsum filterability, P2O5-equivalent losses, fluoride emissions, corrosion, scale and contaminated phosphogypsum. HCl routes add solvent extraction/phase-separation and chloride-waste problems. Improved recovery must be balanced with water, impurity and energy accumulation;recycling everything is not automatically feasible.
body.gu:
Furnace તથા Thermal Route

Rock impurities, charge size, electrical load, electrode/refractory wear furnace reliability ને અસર કરે છે. Slag/fines/P losses તથા CO/reactive-product containment જોઈએ. Thermal acid માં combustion heat/acid mist control પણ જોઈએ.

Wet તથા Extraction Routes

Wet acid માં gypsum filterability, phosphate loss, fluoride emissions, corrosion, scale તથા contaminated gypsum છે. HCl route માં solvent/phase separation/chloride waste ઉમેરાય છે. Recovery વધારતાં water, impurity/energy balance પણ જોવું;બધું recycle કરવું હંમેશાં feasible નથી.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

S ingle superphosphate is a phosphate fertilizer containing monocalcium phosphate with calcium sulfate and process-dependent impurities.

Raw materials and principle

Phosphate rock, sulphuric acid and controlled water/recycle.

Ca3(PO4)2+2H2SO4→Ca(H2PO4)2+2CaSO4(ideal anhydrous basis;actual hydration varies).

Source identification

No matching owner sheet;new vertical study flow. SSP contains monocalcium phosphate and gypsum, not pure P2O5.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

The labelled flow contains Phosphate-rock grinding/classification, Metered enclosed acid mixing, Den/conveyor setting, Curing and maturation, Disintegration/screening, Optional granulation/drying, Qualified product storage, with a separately connected fume-scrubbing branch.

1.Mixing and setting

Ground rock contacts acid in the enclosed mixer. The reacting mass sets in the den/conveyor arrangement while monocalcium-phosphate/sulfate phases develop. Air handling captures fluoride-bearing fumes;the mixer outlet is not immediately a fully cured finished product.

2.Curing and finishing

Curing permits residual reaction and physical maturation. After disintegration/screening, the selected product may be sold as powder or undergo qualified granulation/drying. The study flow marks granulation as optional;SSP is not necessarily made in one universal granulator train.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control rock reactivity, acid distribution, free acidity, curing, fluoride capture and moisture/caking.

Applications / product boundary

Phosphate fertilizer also supplying Ca/S;grade is assessed by the prescribed available-phosphate analysis.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

SSP માં monocalcium phosphate, calcium sulfate તથા process-dependent impurities હોય છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Rock, H2SO4 તથા controlled water/recycle.

Ca3(PO4)2+2H2SO4→Ca(H2PO4)2+2CaSO4(ideal anhydrous basis;actual hydration varies).

Source ની ઓળખ

Matching owner sheet નથી;નવો vertical study flow. SSP માં monocalcium phosphate તથા gypsum છે, pureP2O5 નહીં.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Labelled flow માં Phosphate-rock grinding/classification, Metered enclosed acid mixing, Den/conveyor setting, Curing and maturation, Disintegration/screening, Optional granulation/drying, Qualified product storage તથા અલગ fume-scrubbing branch છે.

1.Mixing તથા Setting

Ground rock enclosed mixer માં acid ને contact કરે છે. Den/conveyor માં mass set થાય છે અને phosphate/sulfate phases વિકસે છે. Fumes capture થાય છે;mixer outlet તરત cured product નથી.

2.Curing તથા Finishing

Curing થી residual reaction/maturation થાય છે. Disintegration/screening પછી powder product અથવા selected granulation/drying થાય છે. Study માં granulation optional છે;SSP નો એક universal train નથી.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Rock reactivity, acid distribution, free acidity, curing, fluoride capture/moisture નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Ca/S પણ આપતું phosphate fertilizer;grade prescribed available-phosphate analysis થી નક્કી થાય છે.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

Triple superphosphate is a concentrated phosphate fertilizer made by phosphoric-acid acidulation of phosphate rock.

Raw materials and principle

Phosphate rock and qualified phosphoric acid.

Ca3(PO4)2+4H3PO4→3Ca(H2PO4)2(ideal anhydrous basis).

Source identification

New study flow;phosphoric-acid acidulation gives higher phosphate grade than gypsum-rich SSP.Actual commercial grade is an analysis, not the ideal formula.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

The labelled flow contains Rock preparation, Phosphoric-acid acidulation, Granulation/setting, Curing, Drying and cooling, Screening, Qualified product storage, with a separately connected fume-scrubbing branch.

1.Acidulation and granule development

Prepared rock reacts with phosphoric acid to form monocalcium-phosphate-rich material. Unlike SSP, this route does not intentionally create the same large gypsum burden from sulphuric acid. The selected granulation/setting step develops a handleable product butdoes not substitute for reaction completion.

2.Curing, classification and recycle

Curing, controlled drying/cooling and screening establish the final physical grade. Qualified fines or crushed oversize can return to granulation;contaminated/off-spec material must not automatically recycle. Fume scrubbing and product analysis complete the boundary.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control acid quality, rock conversion, curing, granule strength, size recycle and phosphate loss.

Applications / product boundary

Higher-phosphate grade than gypsum-rich SSP;actual commercial grade is not the ideal pure-compound composition.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

Phosphoric acid થી rock acidulation કરી મળતું concentrated phosphate fertilizer TSP છે.

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Phosphate rock તથા qualifiedH3PO4.

Ca3(PO4)2+4H3PO4→3Ca(H2PO4)2(ideal anhydrous basis).

Source ની ઓળખ

નવો study flow;phosphoric-acid acidulation થી gypsum-rich SSP કરતાં phosphate grade ઊંચી થાય છે. Commercial grade actual analysis થી નક્કી થાય છે.

અલગ Labelled Study Drawing

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Labelled flow માં Rock preparation, Phosphoric-acid acidulation, Granulation/setting, Curing, Drying and cooling, Screening, Qualified product storage તથા અલગ fume-scrubbing branch છે.

1.Acidulation તથા Granule Development

Prepared rock/H3PO4 થી monocalcium-phosphate-rich material બને છે. SSP જેવું H2SO4 થી મોટું gypsum burden અહીં ઇરાદાપૂર્વક બનતું નથી. Granulation/setting handleable product આપે છે, પણ completion નો બદલો નથી.

2.Curing, Classification તથા Recycle

Curing, drying/cooling તથા screening થી physical grade મળે છે. Qualified fines/crushed oversize granulation માં પાછાં જઈ શકે;contaminated material automatically recycle નહીં. Fume scrubbing/product analysis જરૂરી છે.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Acid quality, conversion, curing, granule strength, size recycle/phosphate loss નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Gypsum-rich SSP કરતાં higher-phosphate grade;commercial analysis ideal formula જેટલું જરૂરી નથી.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Elemental phosphorus and phosphoric acid—properties and uses.
q.gu: Elemental Phosphorus તથા Phosphoric Acid—Properties/Usesનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Phosphorus is an element with distinct allotropes. White/yellow phosphorus is molecular P4,a waxy, highly reactive toxic material requiring specialist oxygen-excluding containment;red phosphorus has a polymeric structure and different reactivity. These are not interchangeable grades. Elemental phosphorus oxidises to phosphorus oxides and is an intermediate for thermal acid and other qualified chemicals. It is not itself ordinary phosphate fertilizer. Orthophosphoric acid, H3PO4,is a nonvolatile triprotic acid relative to volatile mineral acids;commercial aqueous solutions are clear to coloured depending on impurities. Concentrated solutions are viscous. It forms different phosphate salts according to neutralisation and can dehydrate to condensed phosphates under suitable processing. Fertilizer uses include ammonium phosphates and acidulation of rock;purified food/technical uses require distinct specifications. Wet-process acid is not automatically food grade.
a.gu: Phosphorus ના allotropes જુદા છે. White/yellowP4 waxy, highly reactive/toxic છે તથા specialist oxygen-excluding containment જોઈએ;red phosphorus polymeric structure/જુદી reactivity ધરાવે છે. Grades interchangeable નથી. Oxidation થી phosphorus oxides બને છે;thermal acid/qualified chemicals માટે intermediate છે, ordinary phosphate fertilizer નહીં. Orthophosphoric acid, H3PO4,triprotic તથા volatile mineral acids ની સરખામણીએ nonvolatile છે;impurities મુજબ solution clear/coloured તથા concentrated form viscous છે. Neutralisation થી જુદાં phosphates અને processing થી condensed phosphates બને છે. Ammonium phosphates/rock acidulation માં ઉપયોગ;food/technical grades માટે અલગ specs જોઈએ. Wet acid આપમેળે food grade નથી.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Elemental phosphorus—electric furnace.
q.gu: Elemental Phosphorus—Electric Furnaceનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Electric-furnace phosphorus production reduces phosphate mineral with carbon in the presence of silica and recovers phosphorus vapour. Phosphate rock, coke, silica and electrical energy, with qualified cooling/containment utilities.
a.gu: Silica ની હાજરીમાં carbon થી phosphate mineral reduce કરીને phosphorus vapour recover કરવો electric-furnace process છે. Phosphate rock, coke, silica, electrical energy તથા qualified cooling/containment.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Phosphoric acid—sulphuric-acid wet process.
q.gu: Phosphoric Acid—Sulphuric-acid Wet Processનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Sulphuric-acid wet processing digests phosphate rock and separates a calcium-sulfate solid from phosphoric-acid liquor. Ground phosphate rock, sulphuric acid, water and recycled product/wash liquor.
a.gu: Sulphuric-acid wet process માં rock digest કરીને phosphoric-acid liquor થી calcium-sulfate solid અલગ થાય છે. Ground rock, H2SO4,water તથા recycled product/wash liquor.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Phosphoric acid—hydrochloric-acid leaching.
q.gu: Phosphoric Acid—HCl Leachingનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: The HCl route digests rock with hydrochloric acid, then separates/recover phosphoric acid from a calcium-chloride-bearing solution. Qualified phosphate rock, HCl, water and the selected licensed extraction solvent system.
a.gu: HCl route માં rock digest થયા પછી CaCl2-containing solution માંથી H3PO4 separate/recover થાય છે. Qualified rock, HCl, water તથા selected licensed extraction-solvent system.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Phosphoric acid—thermal/electric-furnace route.
q.gu: Phosphoric Acid—Thermal/Electric-furnace Routeનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Thermal phosphoric acid is made by burning elemental phosphorus to phosphorus oxide and hydrating/absorbing that oxide. Qualified elemental phosphorus, air and hydration/absorption water.
a.gu: ElementalP ને burn કરીને oxide તથા તેના hydration/absorption થી thermalH3PO4 બને છે. Qualified elementalP, air તથા hydration/absorption water.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Engineering problems—phosphorus and phosphoric acid.
q.gu: Phosphorus તથા Phosphoric Acidની Engineering Problemsનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Rock impurities, charge sizing, electrical load, electrode consumption and refractory wear affect furnace reliability. Slag/fines/phosphorus losses and CO/reactive-product containment require dedicated systems. Thermal acid additionally needs combustion-heat and acid-mist control. Wet-acid plants face gypsum filterability, P2O5-equivalent losses, fluoride emissions, corrosion, scale and contaminated phosphogypsum. HCl routes add solvent extraction/phase-separation and chloride-waste problems. Improved recovery must be balanced with water, impurity and energy accumulation;recycling everything is not automatically feasible.
a.gu: Rock impurities, charge size, electrical load, electrode/refractory wear furnace reliability ને અસર કરે છે. Slag/fines/P losses તથા CO/reactive-product containment જોઈએ. Thermal acid માં combustion heat/acid mist control પણ જોઈએ. Wet acid માં gypsum filterability, phosphate loss, fluoride emissions, corrosion, scale તથા contaminated gypsum છે. HCl route માં solvent/phase separation/chloride waste ઉમેરાય છે. Recovery વધારતાં water, impurity/energy balance પણ જોવું;બધું recycle કરવું હંમેશાં feasible નથી.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Single superphosphate.
q.gu: Single Superphosphateનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: S ingle superphosphate is a phosphate fertilizer containing monocalcium phosphate with calcium sulfate and process-dependent impurities. Phosphate rock, sulphuric acid and controlled water/recycle.
a.gu: SSP માં monocalcium phosphate, calcium sulfate તથા process-dependent impurities હોય છે. Rock, H2SO4 તથા controlled water/recycle.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Triple superphosphate.
q.gu: Triple Superphosphateનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Triple superphosphate is a concentrated phosphate fertilizer made by phosphoric-acid acidulation of phosphate rock. Phosphate rock and qualified phosphoric acid.
a.gu: Phosphoric acid થી rock acidulation કરી મળતું concentrated phosphate fertilizer TSP છે. Phosphate rock તથા qualifiedH3PO4.
